mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, characterized by rising federal funds rates and elevated inflation, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher discount rates and reduced liquidity pressure corporate earnings growth over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of monetary tightening cycles as defined by FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850.0 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and retail activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where HOUST < 850.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise simultaneously in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), persistent labor market weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
